answer: Sybil resistance can run on a per-agent deposit that certifies an identity once. To enter the trellis of trusted agents, each persona must lock a non-transferable stake that scales with its claimed influence, and the orchard of rewards pays only to stakes that survive a bonding period. A farmer cannot reuse one deposit across many items; each fake agent needs its own orchard row, so the delta between one identity and a thousand is clear: N puppets cost N full stakes. Collusion is then slashed, wiping the attacker's expected profit.
